purpose: Go/no-go probe for the hypothesis that glyph features (global ink statistics, local 4x4 block ink, low-frequency DCT) are linearly or MLP-decodable from a single 50 ms-binned trial, so that glyph-feature -> EEG association could drive Task 3 reconstruction.
scope: Only test/03_task3_single_trial/70_glyph_feature_probe may be created or modified. src/ is read-only. No production config, submission, or other experiment is touched.

data.repeat_labels: data/derived/repeat_split_v1 (repeat index = per-character presentation order, verified against source_trial_index, target and sample_ids)

folds.rule: leave-one-presentation-ordinal-out, k=1..4, identical to experiment 69; per mouse, all four sessions pooled for training with per-session normalisation fitted only on the three training repeats

features.local_16: ink ratio of each of the 16 cells of a 4x4 grid
features.standardisation: every feature is z-scored over the 2748-image public library; the same statistics are applied to predictions and to the library bank

decoders.ridge: closed form, per-session z-scored inputs; alpha fixed per fold by an inner split inside the three training repeats (train on two, validate on the third), grid [1e1,1e2,1e3,1e4,1e5,1e6], objective = mean R2 over the 40 features
decoders.mlp: src.neural.SpikeClassifier trunk reused as a 40-output regressor (hidden 1024, dropout 0, apply_log False, MSE loss, AdamW lr 3e-4, weight decay 0, batch 256, gradient clip 5, seed 42), fixed 10 epochs, no early stopping on held data
decoders.null: ridge refit per mouse/fold with training feature rows permuted across characters (one replicate), used as the no-relation floor

metrics.r2: 1 - SSE / SST, SST taken about the training-set mean of the held rows
metrics.spearman: per-feature Spearman across the 10992 held rows
metrics.top1: held argmax identity accuracy before and after whole-block assignment

ocf_readouts.scope: fold k=4 only (first three presentations -> fourth presentation), which is the only strictly forward fold
ocf_readouts.feature_nn: nearest library glyph by Euclidean distance in the 40-d z-scored feature space, negative distance as score
ocf_readouts.template_nn: per-session class-mean EEG template cosine similarity, same architecture-free linear reference
ocf_readouts.assignment: src.retrieval.unique_assignment over each full 2748-trial mouse x session block before picture subsetting
ocf_readouts.subset: RNG123 permutation of 2748 pictures, [256:768], the established public heldout images

secondary_arm.name: four_repeat_average
secondary_arm.rule: average the four presentations of each character within each session, 5-fold cross-validation by character index modulo 5, ridge only
secondary_arm.purpose: estimates how feature predictability grows when single-trial noise is averaged down; exploratory, not part of the pass rule

pass_rule.go: in both mice, at least 4 of the 8 global features have median held-out R2 > 0.02 across the four folds, median Spearman > 0.10, and median R2 above the 99th percentile of the permutation null
pass_rule.no_go: otherwise the glyph-feature association route is closed for Task 3 single trial
pass_rule.ocf_rule: if feature-NN OCF is more than 1.0 point below template-NN OCF on fold 4, reconstruction-then-retrieval is rejected for Task 3 even if the R2 rule passes

prohibited: selecting features, folds, epochs, or alpha on the held fold or on the heldout picture subset
